profile.name: Reajul Islam Robin
profile.headline: I build secure, distributed backend systems across fintech and healthcare domains, from clean architecture to message-driven infrastructure.
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 3 years building secure, distributed backend systems across fintech and healthcare domains, using Node.js, .NET Core, and Angular/React on PostgreSQL/SQL Server, Docker, and Kubernetes. Skilled in Domain-Driven Design, event-driven architecture, and message-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ), with a track record of measurable performance and workflow improvements.
profile.education: B.Sc.(Engg.) Computer Science & Engineering · Mawlana Bhashani Science & Technology University (2017–2021)

experience.summary: Building core healthcare microservices (Prescription, Appointment, Telemedicine) with .NET 8, Clean Architecture, and CQRS/MediatR, deployed on Docker Swarm/K3s with GitLab CI/CD.
achievements: Designed and built core microservices (Prescription, Appointment, Telemedicine) using .NET 8, Clean Architecture, and CQRS/MediatR, backed by PostgreSQL/EF Core.

Designed the appointment booking domain with a slot-hold lifecycle supporting multiple convergent release mechanisms, resolving race conditions in concurrent booking flows with real-time updates via WebSockets/SSE.
Integrated SSLCommerz for payments with platform-aware redirects, and implemented per-participant Agora token minting for secure telemedicine video sessions.

Deployed services on Docker Swarm/K3s with GitLab CI/CD, and operated the platform's distributed messaging infrastructure (Kafka, RabbitMQ) with Zipkin tracing, including diagnosing a critical disk-space incident traced to Kafka's storage volume.

experience.summary: Built secure, high-throughput ASP.NET Core Web APIs on Microsoft SQL Server for ConnexPay, a mission-critical fintech platform, aligned with PCI-DSS standards.
achievements: Built secure, high-throughput ASP.NET Core Web APIs on Microsoft SQL Server for ConnexPay, a mission-critical fintech platform, aligned with PCI-DSS standards and robust exception handling.
Integrated third-party payment gateways including Visa, TSYS, and BlueSnap, implementing webhook/IPN handling, transaction validation, and ledger updates.

Applied Domain-Driven Design with layered service abstractions and Repository/Unit of Work patterns, optimizing query performance and helping modularize the monolith toward a microservices-ready architecture.
Automated the client onboarding workflow by redesigning backend processes and database schema, cutting setup time by 30%.
Built Node.js/Express backend services and REST APIs for in-house MERN-stack applications using event-driven, asynchronous design patterns for concurrent, I/O-heavy workloads.

projects.name: The Algomist - DSA Journey
projects.description: A personal DSA preparation tool focused on organizing data structures and algorithms practice into a structured learning routine, with AI-generated topic breakdowns via Grok AI.
highlights: Developed a personal DSA preparation tool that organizes practice into a structured learning routine.
Features AI-generated topic breakdowns via Grok AI.
Includes difficulty progression and progress tracking.

projects.name: mypaw - Pet Healthcare Platform
projects.description: A modular monolith pet healthcare platform built with .NET 8 and Angular, using PostgreSQL with pgvector for semantic search and a RAG triage module for symptom-based recommendations.
highlights: Architected a modular monolith pet healthcare platform with .NET 8 and Angular, using PostgreSQL with pgvector for semantic search.
Migrated the monorepo from Docker Compose to Kubernetes, adding CI/CD pipelines and observability with Serilog, Prometheus, and Grafana.
Built a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) triage module combining Ollama embeddings and the Gemini API for symptom-based recommendations.

projects.name: SNOMED CT Clinical Search API
projects.description: A clinical terminology search API exposing lexical and semantic autocomplete endpoints over the SNOMED CT dataset, with sub-second lookup using tsvector and pgvector.
highlights: Built a clinical terminology search API exposing lexical and semantic autocomplete endpoints over the SNOMED CT dataset.
Designed a denormalized search table with generated tsvector columns and word-similarity matching for fast, accurate lexical search.
Delivered sub-second semantic concept lookup using pgvector embeddings alongside the lexical search path.
